changes_made.explanation: Changed answer from Yes to No. While GPT-2 is used to compute surprisal, this is an algorithmic/probabilistic scoring method, not LLM-as-judge evaluation where an LLM assesses outputs after generation. The paper uses statistical language models for probability estimation, not LLM-based qualitative assessment.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automatic evaluation of image caption diversity using surprisal metrics. It studies how different language models (n-gram vs GPT-2) as probability estimators affect diversity comparisons between human and model-generated captions. The extraction mistakenly interpreted probabilistic scoring as LLM-as-judge evaluation.
